unbroken_blade.name: Path of the Unbroken Blade
unbroken_blade.blurb: Steel will and decisive strikes — the dao of the sword.
unbroken_blade.ceremony: A phantom blade hums at your wrist; flame arts answer your call.
unbroken_blade.stat_note: Starter pack: Ember Palm manual and qi-gathering pills.

still_lotus.name: Path of the Still Lotus
still_lotus.blurb: Rooted qi and patient defense — the dao of the shield.
still_lotus.ceremony: Lotus light settles in your dantian; healing arts bloom within.
still_lotus.stat_note: Starter pack: Lotus Revival manual and clarity pills.

wandering_star.name: Path of the Wandering Star
wandering_star.blurb: Starlight and long breaths — the dao of steady cultivation.
wandering_star.ceremony: A star-mark flickers on your palm; swift arts trail your steps.
wandering_star.stat_note: Starter pack: Swift Slash manual and swiftwind pills.

hidden_ledger.name: Path of the Hidden Ledger
hidden_ledger.blurb: Secrets, karma, and winding roads — the dao of the wanderer.
hidden_ledger.ceremony: Hidden lines trace your fate; soul arts whisper from the ledger.
hidden_ledger.stat_note: Starter pack: Soul Needle manual and an affix stone.
